title: Chat streaming, tools, handoff and recovery UX

checks.check: a code block's copy control names the block and its size
checks.detail: aria-label carries the language and the character count; the wrap carries data-lang

checks.check: copying awaits the clipboard and reports what happened
checks.detail: copyCodeBlock() awaits, sets data-state and says Copy unavailable when neither path works

checks.check: a refused clipboard is copied through a selection fallback
checks.detail: writeClipboard() falls back to a selected textarea before it reports failure

checks.check: the code-block copy never touches the clipboard directly
checks.detail: copyCodeBlock() goes through writeClipboard(), which awaits; the sheet's other 11 call sites belong to other panes and are unchanged by this story

checks.check: a copy is announced, not just painted
checks.detail: copyAnnounce() fills one shared role=status region and copyCodeBlock() calls it

checks.check: a tool call is a disclosure, not a line of text
checks.detail: renderChatTool() returns a <details> with a <summary>

checks.check: its status is a word, not only a colour
checks.detail: the summary prints the status label

checks.check: it states the step, the time and the size of what it was given
checks.detail: step, elapsed milliseconds and argument bytes in the summary

checks.check: opening it shows the arguments, the output and the server's cap
checks.detail: the output label names the 500-character cap

checks.check: the turn counts its tool calls and says whether they worked
checks.detail: chatToolSummary() counts the calls, the failures and the total time

checks.check: the tools are rendered into the turn, above the reply
checks.detail: every tool in `message.tools` is drawn as a disclosure

checks.check: a streaming turn reports elapsed time, first token and size
checks.detail: chatStreamingMeta() measures rather than guesses

checks.check: stopping records how much of the answer had arrived
checks.detail: the stopped handler freezes the character count before it renders

checks.check: a stopped turn says who stopped it and how much was kept
checks.detail: the meta line names the reader and the characters kept

checks.check: stopping hands the composer back with the cursor in the field
checks.detail: the stop handler focuses the composer when the reader stopped it

checks.check: a retry's meaning is decided by what the failed attempt did
checks.detail: chatRetryPlan() reads the failed turn's tool count

checks.check: a turn that ran nothing is a plain retry that replaces the placeholder
checks.detail: no tool calls: Retry, replace

checks.check: a turn that ran tools is asked again, not retried silently
checks.detail: tool calls: Ask again (N tool calls already ran), keep the failed turn

checks.check: the failure card carries the plan and says what will not be repeated
checks.detail: presentChatError() prints the plan's sentence and label

checks.check: retrying keeps the failed turn when it did something
checks.detail: retryChatRequest() splices only when the failed turn is a placeholder

checks.check: the question asked again says so on the question
checks.detail: the user turn carries retryOf, and the transcript renders it

checks.check: the handoff brief names the messages and the tool calls it carries
checks.detail: chatHandoffBrief() counts the conversation and lists the calls

checks.check: the brief carries the context the last reply was sent with
checks.detail: the same context line the transcript shows

checks.check: the handoff explains why it is off, or what it will do
checks.detail: chatHandoffReason() covers nothing, streaming, handed and ready

checks.check: the handoff posts nothing and starts nothing
checks.detail: the handoff writes a composer's text, never a request

checks.check: the browser walk exists and asserts the copy, the tool disclosure and the retry plan
checks.detail: chat_recovery_walk.mjs: 25 recorded checks, clipboard read back, fallback forced, tool disclosure and retry plan asserted

checks.check: the walk covers the six states the ledger asks for
checks.detail: STATES = empty, populated, long, loading, error, recovery

checks.check: the walk reads the clipboard rather than trusting the button
checks.detail: the copied text is compared to the block's own text

checks.check: the state captures are present for every viewport and theme, with a before set
checks.detail: 48 after PNG, 16 before PNG
